nodes_add.name: Swami Virjananda (Virajanand Dandeesha)
nodes_add.note: Blind Sanskrit grammarian of Mathura; taught Dayananda c. 1860–1863; divided books into arsha (true) and anarsha (later, corrupt)

nodes_add.name: The Vedic Samhitas
nodes_add.note: The four collections of Vedic hymns and formulas (Rig, Yajur, Sama, Atharva); the only scripture Dayananda held self-authoritative

nodes_add.name: Swami Shraddhananda (Munshi Ram)
nodes_add.note: Arya Samaj leader; founded Gurukul Kangri (1902); led shuddhi campaign in the 1920s

nodes_add.name: Arya Samaj
nodes_add.note: Founded by Dayananda in Bombay, 10 April 1875; ten principles settled at Lahore, 1877

nodes_update.name: Dayananda Saraswati
nodes_update.note: Arya Samaj founder; born Mul Shankar at Tankara; four Vedic Samhitas as sole self-evident revelation; not Swami Dayananda of Arsha Vidya

edges_upsert.note: The four Vedas 'absolutely free from error, and an authority unto themselves' (statement of beliefs in Satyarth Prakash)
Demoted to secondary authority: accepted only where they agree with the Samhitas
Studied grammar and Vedas with him in Mathura c. 1860–1863; vowed to spread Vedic knowledge as guru-dakshina
Took sannyasa in the Saraswati (Dashanami) order, then rejected Advaita: God and soul 'two distinct entities'; Satyarth Prakash ch. 8–9
Met in Calcutta, Dec 1872–Apr 1873; advised him to lecture in Hindi, which he did thereafter
Met in Calcutta 1872–73; Dayananda rejected the Brahmo abandonment of Vedic infallibility
Arya Samaj leader of the Gurukul party after the 1892–93 split; Gurukul Kangri 1902
Aurobindo's essay 'Dayananda and the Veda' calls him 'the first discoverer of the right clues'; sympathetic but independent Vedic interpretation
Reading Satyarth Prakash led him to Arya Samaj gurukul education

places.name: Mathura
places.what: Study with Virjananda, c. 1860–1863 (arrival 1859 or 1860 in different sources)

places.name: Anand Bagh, Varanasi
places.what: Kashi shastrartha on image worship, 16 November 1869 (Sarda; some secondary sources give 22 October) (city-level coordinates)

places.name: Navlakha Mahal, Udaipur
places.what: Revision of Satyarth Prakash, 1882–83 (Navlakha Mahal stands in Gulab Bagh)

places.name: Ajmer
places.what: Death at the Bhinai House, 30 October 1883

glossary.def: 'Collection.' The four core collections of Vedic hymns and formulas: Rig, Yajur, Sama and Atharva.
A formal public debate on the meaning of scripture between learned opponents, often before a ruler or assembly.
Dayananda's doctrine of three eternal realities: God, individual souls and primal matter (prakriti).
Worship of God through a consecrated image.
'Of the rishis.' Texts held to come from the ancient seers, as against later works by ordinary authors (anarsha).
A fire offering of ghee and fragrant materials with Vedic chanting; also called agnihotra or homa.
An ancient rule allowing a widow or childless wife to have children by an appointed man.
'Purification.' An Arya Samaj rite and campaign to bring converts to other religions into Hinduism.

dayananda-saraswati: Born Mool Shankar Tiwari 12 Feb 1824 Tankara; father Karshanji Lalji Tiwari, mother Yashodabai; left home 1846; Virjananda from 1860; died 30 Oct 1883; Paropkarini Sabha 16 Aug 1880; poisoning account (Nanhi Jaan, Jagannath) -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dayananda_Saraswati
Shivaratri at fourteen, mouse; quote 'This image has not the power to drive away even an insignificant mouse from its presence!'; birth VS 1881 -> https://www.aryasamaj.com/enews/2016/march/5.html
Sister and paternal uncle deaths; left to avoid marriage; sannyasa on Narmada; death 30 Oct 1883 Deepavali; 'Thy will be done', Gayatri -> https://aryasamajbangalore.in/swami-dayanand-saraswati/
Kashi shastrartha 16 Nov 1869, Anand Bagh, Maharaja Ishwari Prasad Narayan Singh, Vishuddhananda, Balashastri, 27+ pandits, outcome contested -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shastrartha

Calcutta: left Benares 16 Apr 1872 (sic, Sarda), left Calcutta 1 Apr 1873; Keshab advised Hindi; Debendranath visited; Shuddha Chaitanya; sannyasa at Chanod on Narbada; Virjananda three years; death Bhinai House Ajmer, Dipawali; Olcott asked for autobiography to 1860 -> https://dn721308.ca.archive.org/0/items/LifeOfDayanandSaraswatiHarBilasSarda/Life%20of%20Dayanand%20Saraswati%20-Har%20Bilas%20Sarda.epub
Arya Samaj founded Bombay 10 April 1875; principles settled Lahore 1877; shuddhi; 1893 split over vegetarianism -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arya_Samaj
28 principles in 1875 reduced to 10 in 1877; split within ten years of death -> https://hindupedia.com/en/Aryasamaj
Ten principles 1-3, 6 verbatim -> https://aryasamaj.org.fj/THE_TEN_PRINCIPLES.aspx

Statement of beliefs: Vedas 'absolutely free from error, and are an authority unto themselves'; 'works of a dependent character'; God and soul distinct, 'pervader and the pervaded'; three beginningless; moksha then return; class 'determined by his merits'; 'dead, inert objects'; 'So - called sacred places on land and water are not tirthas'; Bhagvat 'not true (real) Puranas' -> https://www.esamskriti.com/e/History/Great-Indian-Leaders/My-Beliefs-By-Swami-Dayanand-Saraswati-1.aspx
'two distinct entities'; moksha 'lasts for a period only' -> https://www.esamskriti.com/essays/textfile/13_389_763.txt
Sandhya, svadhyay, homa, five mahayajnas, sixteen sanskars, service to living parents -> https://www.esamskriti.com/essays/textfile/aryarelig.txt

Satyarth Prakash 1875 Benares Star Press; 2nd ed. VS 1939 (1882–83) Udaipur; 14 chapters (11 Indian sects, 12 Charvaka/Buddhism/Jainism, 13 Christianity, 14 Islam); Sind ban 1944; Delhi HC 2008 petition dismissed; English tr. 1906 Bharadwaja -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satyarth_Prakash
Parantakala, return after; denial of incarnation; murtipuja defective; niyoga accepted within rules; Advaita rejected ch. 8–9 -> https://hindupedia.com/en/Saty%C4%81rthaprak%C4%81%C5%9Ba
Vedas given to Agni, Vayu, Aditya and Angira -> https://aryagan.org/about-vedas.html
'there are no stories in the Vedas'; Parmanand tr. 1981 -> https://vedicscriptures.in/public/pdf/rigvedadibhashyabhumika-swami-dayanand-sarswati-english.pdf

Samhitas only authoritative; Upanishads/Brahmanas secondary; reinterpreted Agni; Indra-Vritra demythologised into science and conduct; influence of Christian/Muslim fundamentalism; science in Veda -> https://gospelstudies.org.uk/biblicalstudies/pdf/ijt/31-3-4_175.pdf

Aurobindo: 'first discoverer of the right clues'; 'nothing fantastic in Dayananda's idea that Veda contains truth of science as well as truth of religion' -> https://sri-aurobindo.co.in/workings/sa/17/0083_e.htm

Theosophical alliance 22 May 1878 to March 1882; 26 March 1882 Bombay lecture; called founders converts to Buddhism -> https://theosophy.wiki/en/Theosophical_Society_of_the_Arya_Samaj ; https://theosophy.wiki/en/Dayanand

Virjananda b. 1778 Kartarpur, d. 14 Sept 1868, blind from smallpox at five, Mathura pathshala, no fees; told Dayananda to throw Kaumudi into Yamuna -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virajanand_Dandeesha
Satyarth Prakash English scan -> https://archive.org/details/satyarthprakashl00dayauoft
Salmond, Hindu Iconoclasts (2004) catalog -> https://biblioteca.izt.uam.mx/vufind/Record/musev2_12241
